description: After Haiku synthesis rewrites PERSONA.md from observations.jsonl, observations older than the synthesis timestamp are already distilled and redundant. Truncate observations.jsonl to post-synthesis entries only, moving the rest to observations.archive.jsonl. Prevents unbounded growth of the raw observation log. Synthesis is the scaling mechanism — this makes it effective.
title: Prune observations.jsonl after synthesis — archive pre-synthesis entries
